Give up the key.
Not your identity.
settings.text: Numbered seals let a keyholder verify from anywhere. SIGNATURE pieces are made in small numbered runs, the kind of thing you give, not just buy.
Every VANTA FORM piece is designed, engineered and manufactured by our own team. That's why we can size it to you, replace a single part, and stand behind every lock for life.
